pt_BR.terminal: PT LOC HOLD: KEELMARK LOSS: biological workforce converted to unrecoverable loss. Claim continuity retained pending material and proof custody.
pt_BR.audio: PT LOC HOLD: This is where dead workers became a clean column.
pt_BR.in_game_wiki: PT LOC HOLD: The proof chain ends in claim conversion: Deep Reach can admit damage while keeping ownership if people become losses and evidence becomes material custody.
pt_BR.external_site: PT LOC HOLD: The Deep Reach lie is not one memo. It is a chain from physical disaster to evacuation delay to insurance conversion.
pt_BR.field_note: PT LOC HOLD: Final proof stands between the public ledger and the payload receiver: one preserves the dead, the other controls the claim.
